papers.title: Astrocytic sEH-EET signaling regulates microglial lysosomal function and suppresses the STING-Type I interferon pathway in Alzheimer's disease
papers.translated_title: 星形胶质细胞sEH-EET信号调控小胶质细胞溶酶体功能并抑制阿尔茨海默病中的STING-I型干扰素通路
papers.author: Ghosh, B.
papers.summary: Background: The development of {beta}-amyloid (A{beta}) pathology in Alzheimer's disease (AD) is accompanied by profound changes in astrocytes and microglia and associated neuroinflammation. Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH), which degrades anti-inflammatory epoxyeicosatrienoic acids (EETs), is elevated in the AD brain, yet how EETs restrain inflammation remains poorly understood. Methods: We performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) on brains from wild-type, sEH knockout, 5xFAD, and 5xFAD; sEH knockout mice, and used primary mouse microglia and human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived microglia to define the underlying mechanism. To test cell-type-specific contributions, we generated astrocyte- and endothelial-specific she knockout mice and crossed them with 5xFAD mice. Results: Genetic disruption of sEH in 5xFAD mice markedly reduced the abundance of a type I interferon (IFN)-responsive microglial subcluster and lowered phospho-STING (pSTING) levels. In primary microglia, supplementation with 11,12-EET attenuated STING activation and IFN target gene expression; blocking lysosomal acidification abolished this effect and caused pSTING to accumulate, identifying lysosomal degradation as a critical route for terminating STING signaling. 11,12-EET also enhanced microglial lysosomal acidification and A{beta} phagocytosis. Astrocytic, but not endothelial, disruption of sEH recapitulated the reductions in A{beta} pathology and microglial STING activation seen in global sEH-deficient mice, identifying astrocytes as the major cellular source of EETs regulating this pathway. Conclusion: We define an astrocyte-microglia axis in which astrocytic sEH limits EET availability and thereby sustains microglial STING signaling. By promoting lysosomal clearance of pSTING, EETs suppress type I IFN signaling and enhance microglial A{beta} clearance, highlighting sEH inhibition as a therapeutic strategy targeting both neuroinflammation and lysosomal dysfunction in AD.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：阿尔茨海默病（AD）中β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）病理的发展伴随着星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的深刻变化以及相关的神经炎症。可溶性环氧化物水解酶（sEH）可降解抗炎性环氧二十碳三烯酸（EETs），在AD脑中升高，然而EETs如何抑制炎症仍知之甚少。方法：我们对野生型、sEH敲除、5xFAD和5xFAD；sEH敲除小鼠的脑组织进行了单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq），并使用原代小鼠小胶质细胞和人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的小胶质细胞来确定潜在机制。为测试细胞类型特异性贡献，我们构建了星形胶质细胞特异性和内皮细胞特异性sEH敲除小鼠，并将其与5xFAD小鼠杂交。结果：在5xFAD小鼠中遗传性破坏sEH显著降低了I型干扰素（IFN）反应性小胶质细胞亚群的丰度，并降低了磷酸化STING（pSTING）水平。在原代小胶质细胞中，补充11,12-EET减弱了STING激活和IFN靶基因表达；阻断溶酶体酸化消除了这一效应并导致pSTING积累，确定溶酶体降解是终止STING信号传导的关键途径。11,12-EET还增强了小胶质细胞溶酶体酸化和Aβ吞噬作用。星形胶质细胞而非内皮细胞中sEH的破坏再现了全局sEH缺陷小鼠中所见的Aβ病理减少和小胶质细胞STING激活降低，确定星形胶质细胞是调节该通路的EETs的主要细胞来源。结论：我们定义了一个星形胶质细胞-小胶质细胞轴，其中星形胶质细胞sEH限制了EET的可利用性，从而维持小胶质细胞STING信号传导。通过促进pSTING的溶酶体清除，EETs抑制I型IFN信号传导并增强小胶质细胞Aβ清除，突出表明sEH抑制是一种同时靶向AD中神经炎症和溶酶体功能障碍的治疗策略。

papers.title: GOLDEN: Gene expression and allele-informed decomposition for genetic heterogeneity in spatial transcriptomic data
papers.translated_title: GOLDEN：空间转录组数据中遗传异质性的基因表达与等位基因信息分解
papers.author: Paik, H.
papers.summary: Motivation Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables exploration of cellular interactions, including immune responses. However, current methods rely on pathologists, with limitations in addressing genetic heterogeneity, where niches harboring nonclonal cells, including placental or allograft tissues, are present. Deciphering these interindividual mixtures remains challenging. Results For deciphering interindividual heterogeneity in ST, we developed GOLDEN (Gene expressiOn and aLlele-informed DEcomposition for geNetic heterogeneity), which involves an allele-aware multitask network that encodes spot-level expressions into shared latent representations. Incorporating allele features, dual heads classify spot identity (target, nontarget, or mixed) and estimate target fractions. We utilized synthetic ST data with spot-level ground truth using semiallogeneic single-cell profiles. For these synthetic benchmarks, GOLDEN achieved reliable deconvolution, with high correlation (Pearson's r = 0.977) and low error (mean absolute error (MAE) = 0.045) in fraction estimation and consistent predictions across real-world STs. These predictions were genetically validated. Using GOLDEN, resolving spot-level genetic heterogeneity is feasible. Availability and implementation GOLDEN and the simulation code for ST are available at https://github.com/othertics/GOLDEN.
papers.translated_summary: 动机 空间转录组学（ST）能够探索细胞相互作用，包括免疫反应。然而，当前方法依赖病理学家，在解决遗传异质性方面存在局限，其中存在包含非克隆细胞的微环境，包括胎盘或同种异体移植组织。解读这些个体间混合仍然具有挑战性。结果 为了解读ST中的个体间异质性，我们开发了GOLDEN（基因表达与等位基因信息驱动的遗传异质性分解），其涉及一个等位基因感知的多任务网络，将spot水平表达编码为共享潜在表示。结合等位基因特征，双头分类spot身份（目标、非目标或混合）并估计目标比例。我们利用半同种异体单细胞谱构建了具有spot水平真实标签的合成ST数据。对于这些合成基准，GOLDEN实现了可靠的去卷积，在比例估计中具有高相关性（Pearson's r = 0.977）和低误差（平均绝对误差（MAE）= 0.045），并在真实世界ST中具有一致的预测。这些预测经过了遗传验证。使用GOLDEN，解析spot水平遗传异质性是可行的。可用性与实现 GOLDEN及ST的模拟代码可在https://github.com/othertics/GOLDEN获取。

papers.title: Asymmetric listening conditions perturb verbal and nonverbal coordination dynamics during conversation
papers.translated_title: 不对称倾听条件会扰动对话中的言语与非言语协调动态
papers.author: He, H.
papers.summary: Human conversation depends on continuous coordination across verbal and nonverbal behaviour. Yet this coordination may become perturbed when one person experiences greater listening difficulty. Previous nonverbal joint action studies show that unequal task demands between partners can lead to complementary leader-follower dynamics, but whether similar patterns emerge during natural conversation remains unclear. We investigated how unequal listening conditions affect verbal and nonverbal coordination in 40 same-gender stranger dyads during three 10-minute face-to-face conversations. Each dyad participated in noise-free and asymmetric noise conditions, with one person exposed to speech-shaped noise at a time. Asymmetric noise reduced conversational flow and enjoyment, and shifted the balance of verbal contributions: noise-exposed participants took longer turns and contributed more speaking time, while their noise-free partners produced more backchannels. Interpersonal head-movement coordination became temporally asymmetric under noise, with movements of the noise-exposed participant more often preceding those of their partner. In contrast, interpersonal hand-movement coordination did not differ between conditions. Within individuals, hand coordination was stronger when participants themselves experienced noise than when their partner experienced noise. These findings demonstrate that perturbing one partner's auditory access affects coordination within and between individuals, revealing how unequal interaction demands produce different coordination patterns across verbal and nonverbal behaviour.
papers.translated_summary: 人类对话依赖于言语和非言语行为之间的持续协调。然而，当一方经历更大的聆听困难时，这种协调可能会受到扰动。以往的非言语联合行动研究表明，伙伴之间不平等的任务需求可能导致互补的领导—跟随动态，但自然对话中是否出现类似模式仍不清楚。我们研究了不平等的聆听条件如何影响40对同性别陌生配对在三次10分钟面对面对话中的言语和非言语协调。每对参与者参与了无噪声和非对称噪声两种条件，每次只有一人暴露于语音形噪声中。非对称噪声降低了对话流畅性和愉悦感，并改变了言语贡献的平衡：暴露于噪声的参与者话轮更长、说话时间更多，而其无噪声伙伴产生了更多的回应性反馈。在噪声条件下，人际头部运动协调在时间上变得不对称，暴露于噪声的参与者的运动更频繁地先于其伙伴的运动。相比之下，人际手部运动协调在两种条件之间没有差异。在个体内部，当参与者自身经历噪声时，手部协调比其伙伴经历噪声时更强。这些发现表明，扰动一方的听觉获取会影响个体内部和个体之间的协调，揭示了不平等的互动需求如何在言语和非言语行为中产生不同的协调模式。

papers.title: Combing agronomic biofortification with a Zn-efficient wheat line synergistically increases grain Zn concentrations with varied effects on Cd in wheat grains
papers.translated_title: 将农艺生物强化与锌高效小麦品系相结合，可协同提高小麦籽粒锌浓度，并对小麦籽粒镉产生不同影响
papers.author: Bachelder, J.
papers.summary: (Background and aims) Wheat grains are often too low in zinc (Zn) compared to human dietary needs, and are a major dietary source of highly toxic cadmium (Cd). Biofortification strategies can increase Zn in edible grain, but must not increase grain Cd. (Methods) We investigated the individual and combined effects of genetic and agronomic biofortification on Zn and Cd in wheat grains. Non-transgenic Bobwhite (BW-NT) and an OsNAS2-expressing line (BW-NAS) were grown in a pot experiment with isotope-labeled mineral Zn (70Zn) and green manure (70Zn, 106Cd). At flowering and maturity, Zn and Cd were quantified in wheat biomass. Wheat contents of Zn and Cd derived from inputs versus soil were determined using stable isotope analyses. (Results) Individually, the OsNAS2-expressing wheat and input application increased grain Zn. Combined OsNAS2 expression and input application led to grain concentrations of 76{+/-}4 mg kg-1 with mineral Zn application and 61{+/-}7 mg kg-1 with green manure. This was 154-217% higher than the 24{+/-}1 mg kg-1 observed in the BW-NT control and significantly higher than the additive effects of each strategy individually. The OsNAS2-expressing line increased grain Cd to 0.214{+/-}0.002 mg kg-1 under green manure, compared to 0.12{+/-}0.01 mg kg-1 in the BW-NT control. No other treatment increased grain Cd. (Conclusions) Our results encourage development of integrated genetic and agronomic biofortification strategies to increase grain Zn. They also underscore the need for careful monitoring of grain Cd concentrations when organic amendments are paired with genetic biofortification strategies.
papers.translated_summary: （背景与目标）与人类膳食需求相比，小麦籽粒中的锌（Zn）含量往往过低，同时小麦也是高毒性镉（Cd）的主要膳食来源。生物强化策略可以提高可食用籽粒中的锌含量，但不得增加籽粒镉含量。（方法）我们研究了遗传生物强化和农艺生物强化对小麦籽粒中锌和镉的单独效应及联合效应。将非转基因Bobwhite（BW-NT）和一个表达OsNAS2的株系（BW-NAS）种植于盆栽试验中，施用同位素标记的矿质锌（70Zn）和绿肥（70Zn、106Cd）。在开花期和成熟期，对小麦生物量中的锌和镉进行定量分析。利用稳定同位素分析测定小麦中来源于投入物与来源于土壤的锌和镉含量。（结果）单独而言，表达OsNAS2的小麦和投入物施用均提高了籽粒锌含量。OsNAS2表达与投入物施用相结合，在施用矿质锌时使籽粒浓度达到76{+/-}4 mg kg-1，在施用绿肥时达到61{+/-}7 mg kg-1。这比BW-NT对照中观察到的24{+/-}1 mg kg-1高154-217%，且显著高于每种策略单独效应的加和。在绿肥处理下，表达OsNAS2的株系使籽粒镉含量提高至0.214{+/-}0.002 mg kg-1，而BW-NT对照为0.12{+/-}0.01 mg kg-1。其他处理均未提高籽粒镉含量。（结论）我们的结果支持开发遗传与农艺相结合的综合生物强化策略以提高籽粒锌含量。结果也强调，当有机改良剂与遗传生物强化策略配合使用时，需要仔细监测籽粒镉浓度。

papers.title: Comparing re-referencing methods for human intracranial EEG
papers.translated_title: 比较人类颅内脑电图的重新参考方法
papers.author: Kolibius, L. D.
papers.summary: Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) involves the implantation of depth electrodes in the brain to monitor epileptic seizures for surgical feasibility. As the electrodes advance into deeper limbic structures, the macro contacts distributed along the shaft record electrical activity from more lateral sites, while a bundled array of microwires simultaneously captures highly localised signals from the tip of the electrode. In a clinical setting these electrical signals are recorded relative to a reference signal, which may be sub-optimal for subsequent analyses that are unrelated to clinical objectives. Therefore, a secondary re-referencing operation is often undertaken to transform the signal in relation to a specific hypothesis. Despite a recent surge in SEEG studies, comparative studies on the much-understudied issue of re-referencing are sparse. Here, we analyse data collected from 16 human patients during an episodic memory task and comparatively apply a range of re-referencing methods to both macro contact and micro-wire data. We find that the choice of method changes the proportion of trials that survive artefact rejection, low frequency power, and the aperiodic background against which that power is read. In the hippocampal recordings, however, no method differed from any other in the size of a memory effect in power or spike-field coherence. This early transformative decision therefore bears on how the signal is described. We found no evidence that it changes the detectability of the behavioural effects tested here, and no method reversed the direction of a memory effect.
papers.translated_summary: 立体脑电图（SEEG）通过在大脑中植入深部电极来监测癫痫发作，以评估手术可行性。随着电极深入边缘系统结构，沿电极杆分布的宏观触点记录来自更外侧位点的电活动，而一束微丝阵列同时捕获电极尖端高度局部化的信号。在临床环境中，这些电信号是相对于参考信号记录的，这对于与临床目标无关的后续分析可能并非最优。因此，通常会进行二次重参考操作，以根据特定假设对信号进行变换。尽管近年来SEEG研究激增，但关于重参考这一研究不足问题的比较研究却很稀少。在此，我们分析了16名人类患者在情景记忆任务期间收集的数据，并对宏观触点和微丝数据比较应用了一系列重参考方法。我们发现，方法的选择会改变通过伪迹剔除的试次比例、低频功率以及读取该功率所依据的非周期背景。然而，在海马记录中，没有任何方法在功率或 spike-field 相干性的记忆效应大小上与其他方法不同。因此，这一早期的变换决策关系到信号如何被描述。我们未发现证据表明它会改变此处测试的行为效应的可检测性，也没有任何方法逆转了记忆效应的方向。

papers.title: Learned Audiovisual Predictability Modulates Depth-Resolved Hippocampal-Cortical Functional Coupling
papers.translated_title: 习得的视听可预测性调节深度分辨的海马-皮层功能耦合
papers.author: Sozzi, S.
papers.summary: Perception reflects the dynamic integration of prior expectations, uncertainty, and incoming sensory evidence, but the neural circuitry supporting these computations remains debated. Current theories implicate coordinated interactions between the hippocampus and neocortex, potentially at the level of hippocampal subfields and cortical layers. Evidence in humans has come primarily from the visual domain, while less is known about how these interactions support learned auditory predictions. Using submillimetre 7T fMRI, we investigated depth-resolved functional coupling between hippocampal subfields and temporal and frontal cortical regions during audiovisual associative prediction. Participants learned deterministic associations between visual cues and auditory syllables, allowing us to compare auditory processing in predictable and unpredictable contexts. Predictability-related connectivity changes showed a spatially structured pattern involving DG/CA3-pSTG and CA1-inferior frontal regions, with significant edge-wise effects resolved across cortical depths. These findings provide fine-grained evidence that learned auditory predictability modulates hippocampal-cortical functional interactions across temporo-frontal systems.
papers.translated_summary: 知觉反映了先验预期、不确定性与传入感觉证据的动态整合，但支持这些计算的神经环路仍存在争议。现有理论认为海马与新皮层之间存在协调互动，可能发生在海马亚区与皮层分层水平。来自人类的证据主要集中于视觉领域，而关于这些互动如何支持习得性听觉预测则知之甚少。我们利用亚毫米7T fMRI，研究了在视听联想预测过程中海马亚区与颞叶及额叶皮层区域之间深度分辨的功能耦合。参与者学习了视觉线索与听觉音节之间的确定性关联，使我们能够比较可预测与不可预测情境下的听觉加工。与可预测性相关的连接变化呈现出涉及DG/CA3-pSTG和CA1-额下区的空间结构化模式，并在皮层深度上解析出显著的边效应。这些发现提供了精细证据，表明习得性听觉可预测性调节了跨颞-额系统的海马-皮层功能互动。

papers.title: Intelligent systems distribute memory across internal and embodied resources
papers.translated_title: 智能系统将记忆分布于内部资源和具身资源之中
papers.author: Zhang, R.
papers.summary: Intelligent systems do not operate in isolation from the body, yet how bodily actions support internal computation remains unclear. Here we show that primates and artificial agents recruit eye movements to maintain beliefs about hidden goals when internal computation is constrained. In a naturalistic navigation task, both systems spontaneously tracked goals with their eyes after they disappeared from view. This strategy emerged in artificial agents only when internal memory was constrained, identifying resource constraints as a driver of memory externalization. Restricting gaze impaired performance in both systems, while natural behavioral variability and causal perturbations in agents established a direct influence of oculomotor state on internal beliefs about hidden goals. Across agents, varying the reliability of internal memory and gaze redistributed goal information between internal and embodied states. The same resource-allocation principle predicted the distribution of goal information in macaque parietal cortex, where greater reliance on gaze was accompanied by weaker gaze-independent neural representations. Together, these findings identify eye movements as embodied memory and reveal a convergent principle across intelligent systems: memory is allocated across internal and embodied resources according to their reliability.
papers.translated_summary: 智能系统并非脱离身体孤立运作，但身体动作如何支持内部计算仍不清楚。本研究表明，当内部计算受到约束时，灵长类动物和人工代理都会调用眼动来维持对隐藏目标的信念。在一项自然istic导航任务中，两个系统都在目标从视野中消失后自发地以眼动追踪目标。这种策略仅在人工代理的内部记忆受到约束时才出现，从而将资源约束确定为记忆外化的驱动因素。限制注视会损害两个系统的表现，而代理中的自然行为变异和因果扰动则确立了眼动状态对关于隐藏目标的内部信念的直接影响。在不同代理中，改变内部记忆和注视的可靠性会在内部状态与具身状态之间重新分配目标信息。同样的资源分配原则预测了猕猴顶叶皮层中目标信息的分布，其中对注视的更大依赖伴随着更弱的独立于注视的神经表征。总之，这些发现将眼动确定为具身记忆，并揭示了跨智能系统的一个趋同原则：记忆根据内部资源和具身资源的可靠性在其间进行分配。

papers.title: Dietary vitamin B5 positively regulates intestinal neuropeptide secretion in C. elegans
papers.translated_title: 膳食维生素B5正向调控秀丽隐杆线虫肠道神经肽分泌
papers.author: Jia, Q.
papers.summary: Vitamin B5 is an essential vitamin that must be acquired via diet or by the gut microbiota, and vitamin B5 deficiency or altered vitamin B5 metabolism leads to a variety of physiological and neuronal disorders. We conducted a genetic analysis of the effects of exogenous vitamin B5 in C. elegans, and we found that vitamin B5 confers protection to toxicity caused by oxidative stress and acute exposure to vitamin B5 positively regulates neuropeptide secretion. We identified a sodium-dependent multivitamin transporter family member, smvt-1 that is required for B5 uptake into cells and for protection conferred by vitamin B5. Vitamin B5 positively regulates the intestinal secretion of FLP-2, a neuropeptide-like protein whose release activates the antioxidant response. Vitamin B5 promotes FLP-2 secretion rapidly, specifically, and in a manner that is dependent upon uptake into intestinal cells by smvt-1. Vitamin B5-induced neuropeptide secretion is strictly dependent upon the SNARE protein aex-4/SNAP-25 and on the calcium dependent protein kinase C family member, pkc-2/PKCa in the intestine. These results reveal a previously uncharacterized function for dietary vitamin B5 in positively regulating intestinal neuropeptide secretion from dense core vesicles and in shaping the antioxidant response.
papers.translated_summary: 维生素B5是一种必需维生素，必须通过饮食或肠道微生物群获得，维生素B5缺乏或维生素B5代谢改变会导致多种生理和神经元疾病。我们对秀丽隐杆线虫中外源性维生素B5的作用进行了遗传学分析，发现维生素B5对氧化应激引起的毒性具有保护作用，并且急性暴露于维生素B5正向调节神经肽分泌。我们鉴定了一个钠依赖性多种维生素转运蛋白家族成员smvt-1，它是维生素B5摄取进入细胞以及维生素B5所赋予保护作用所必需的。维生素B5正向调节肠道分泌FLP-2，FLP-2是一种神经肽样蛋白，其释放激活抗氧化反应。维生素B5促进FLP-2分泌，这一过程快速、特异，并以依赖于smvt-1摄取进入肠道细胞的方式进行。维生素B5诱导的神经肽分泌严格依赖于肠道中的SNARE蛋白aex-4/SNAP-25以及钙依赖性蛋白激酶C家族成员pkc-2/PKCa。这些结果揭示了膳食维生素B5一个此前未被表征的功能，即正向调节致密核心囊泡的肠道神经肽分泌并塑造抗氧化反应。

papers.title: A community benchmark enables high-resolution, cross-lab quantification of mouse social behavior
papers.translated_title: 一个社区基准实现了对小鼠社会行为的高分辨率、跨实验室量化
papers.author: Marks, M.
papers.summary: Social behavior is a sensitive readout of brain state, but quantifying rodent social behavior at scale has relied on siloed, lab-specific tools. We assembled Days of our Mice (DooM), a benchmark of manually annotated video and pose tracking spanning 15 laboratories and 33 social and solitary behaviors, and hosted a community behavior classification challenge. We built on challenge solutions to develop the High-Dimensional Rodent Annotator (HiDRA), a behavior classification tool that generalizes to labs unseen during training and learns cross-lab movement features. Applied without retraining to experimental data, HiDRA resolves line-specific and state-dependent behavioral fingerprints with strong generalizability and reproducibility, establishing high-resolution, shareable social phenotyping as a scalable readout of brain and internal state. We release the DooM dataset and HiDRA classifiers as open resources.
papers.translated_summary: 社会行为是脑状态的一种敏感读出指标，但大规模量化啮齿动物的社会行为一直依赖于各自为政的实验室专用工具。我们构建了Days of our Mice（DooM），这是一个涵盖15个实验室、33种社会与独居行为的人工标注视频与姿态追踪基准，并举办了一场社区行为分类挑战赛。我们基于挑战赛的解决方案开发了High-Dimensional Rodent Annotator（HiDRA），这是一种行为分类工具，能够泛化到训练期间未见过的实验室，并学习跨实验室的运动特征。在未经重新训练的情况下应用于实验数据，HiDRA能够以强泛化性和可重复性解析品系特异性和状态依赖性的行为指纹，从而将高分辨率、可共享的社会表型分析确立为脑与内部状态的可扩展读出指标。我们将DooM数据集和HiDRA分类器作为开放资源发布。

papers.title: Infantile amnesia results from differential memory retrieval in humans
papers.translated_title: 婴儿期遗忘源于人类记忆提取的差异
papers.author: Power, S. D.
papers.summary: Infantile amnesia, the inability to recall memories from our earliest years, is the most common form of forgetting in mammals. Whether early memories never form, decay, or persist but become inaccessible remains unknown. Here, we investigated the nature of forgetting during the infantile amnesia period by longitudinally testing toddlers aged 18-24 months across the complete memory cycle from encoding, initial retrieval one day later, and delayed retrieval up to six months later, in a novel naturalistic episodic memory paradigm. Computational modelling revealed that forgetting during the infantile amnesia period was heterogeneous. Toddlers were as likely to retain the full memory as to lose it completely, while nearly a quarter retained only part of the memory. Encoding accuracy predicted which toddlers retained the full memory at the test one day later, but not at the delayed test up to six months on. Instead, a retrieval-specific EEG signature predicted complete, but not partial, memory retrieval, distinguishing which toddlers had retained the full memory before their behavioural response. Finally, leveraging the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment, we found that maternal immune activation during pregnancy, as in rodents, alters vulnerability to infantile forgetting in humans. Together, these findings show that early memories formed during the infantile amnesia period are not simply erased but persist in an increasingly inaccessible form, a transformation whose trajectory can be shaped by both the neural retrieval mechanism and the prenatal environment.
papers.translated_summary: 婴儿期遗忘，即无法回忆生命最早几年的记忆，是哺乳动物中最常见的遗忘形式。早期记忆究竟是从未形成、逐渐衰退，还是持续存在但变得无法提取，目前仍不清楚。本研究采用一种新颖的自然情境情景记忆范式，对18至24个月大的幼儿进行纵向测试，覆盖从编码、一天后的初次提取到长达六个月后的延迟提取的完整记忆周期，以探究婴儿期遗忘阶段的遗忘本质。计算建模揭示，婴儿期遗忘阶段的遗忘具有异质性。幼儿保留完整记忆与完全遗忘记忆的可能性相当，而近四分之一的幼儿仅保留了部分记忆。编码准确性预测了哪些幼儿在一天后的测试中保留了完整记忆，但不能预测长达六个月后的延迟测试中的表现。相反，一种提取特异性的脑电特征预测了完整记忆提取而非部分记忆提取，能够在幼儿做出行为反应之前区分出哪些幼儿保留了完整记忆。最后，利用COVID-19大流行作为自然实验，我们发现孕期母体免疫激活如同在啮齿动物中一样，改变了人类对婴儿期遗忘的易感性。综上，这些发现表明，在婴儿期遗忘阶段形成的早期记忆并非被简单抹除，而是以日益难以提取的形式持续存在，这一转变的轨迹可受到神经提取机制和产前环境的共同塑造。

papers.title: Resistance Training Frequency and Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Volume-Equated Trials
papers.translated_title: 抗阻训练频率与肌肉肥大：容量等同试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Boutagy, A. G.
papers.summary: Weekly training volume is the primary driver of resistance-training hypertrophy, but the independent role of frequency can be isolated only when weekly volume is equated. We quantified the effect of training frequency on hypertrophy across one to three volume-equated sessions per muscle per week. Following PRISMA 2020, five databases were searched to October 2026 for trials of at least six weeks that equated weekly volume between per-muscle frequencies and measured muscle size. One change-score standardized mean difference per trial (Hedges g; negative favoring higher frequency) was pooled with a random-effects model, and certainty was rated with GRADE. Sixteen trials (380 participants) were pooled. The frequency effect was trivial and non-significant (g = -0.02; 95% CI -0.21 to 0.16; I{superscript 2} = 0%; prediction interval -0.23 to 0.18); the interval admits at most a small effect favoring the higher frequency. Contrast-specific estimates were similarly trivial, and no moderator was significant, although the moderator analyses could detect only large effects. Certainty was low to very low. Within this range, the data give no basis for preferring one, two or three sessions at a fixed weekly volume. Most trials measured muscle thickness, which does not track whole-muscle growth reliably.
papers.translated_summary: 每周训练量是抗阻训练诱导肌肉肥大的主要驱动因素，但只有在周训练量相等时，才能分离出训练频率的独立作用。我们量化了每块肌肉每周一到三次训练量相等 sessions 对肌肉肥大的频率效应。遵循 PRISMA 2020，检索了五个数据库至2026年10月，纳入至少六周、在每块肌肉训练频率之间均衡周训练量并测量肌肉大小的试验。每项试验的一个变化分数标准化均数差（Hedges g；负值有利于更高频率）采用随机效应模型合并，并用 GRADE 评定证据确定性。共合并十六项试验（380名参与者）。频率效应微不足道且不显著（g = -0.02；95% CI -0.21至0.16；I{superscript 2} = 0%；预测区间 -0.23至0.18）；该区间至多允许有利于更高频率的小效应。对比特异性估计同样微不足道，且没有调节变量显著，尽管调节变量分析只能检测到大效应。确定性为低至极低。在此范围内，数据没有提供依据在固定周训练量下偏好一次、两次或三次 sessions。大多数试验测量肌肉厚度，而肌肉厚度不能可靠地反映整块肌肉的生长。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model Deployment for Oncology Registry Abstraction: Structure-Aware Evaluation in a Real-World Clinical Setting
papers.translated_title: 面向肿瘤登记抽象任务的隐私保护大型语言模型部署：真实临床环境中的结构感知评估
papers.author: Moldovan, M.
papers.summary: Objectives Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for research and care but remains labour-intensive and error-prone. This study developed and evaluated a privacy-preserving large language model pipeline for oncology registry abstraction in a real-world clinical setting. Methods An open-source Meta Llama 3.3 70B-based pipeline, prompted without task-specific fine-tuning, was deployed to extract over 50 variables from 6,700 oncology notes at a cancer centre in Singapore. Data were de-identified locally using a Hide-In-Plain-Sight approach, ensuring no identifiable data left hospital infrastructure. Performance was assessed on 200 randomly sampled notes with adjudicated ground truth, using a structure-aware framework that classified outputs as correct, missing, spurious, or incorrect. Results F1 scores were high across variables, including diagnosis (97.2%), histology (95.8%), stage (92.6%), biomarkers (91.4%), and treatments (88.1%). Preliminary transferability testing on 50 external notes showed strong performance for core diagnostic variables, with reduced performance for list-valued variables. Discussion The structure-aware evaluation approach separated omissions from fabrications, providing more clinically actionable insight than aggregate metrics alone. Conclusion Privacy-preserving large language models achieved high extraction accuracy under a clinician-verified reference standard, supporting their feasibility for oncology registry abstraction in real-world clinical settings. Keywords: Large language models; Oncology registry abstraction; Natural language processing; Privacy-preserving AI; Clinical data extraction What is already known on this topic Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for cancer research and care but remains labour-intensive, costly, and inconsistent from one reviewer to the next when performed manually. Large language models offer potential to automate this task, but their use in real-world registries has been limited by concerns over patient data privacy, reliance on task-specific fine-tuning, and evaluation methods that obscure the difference between missing and fabricated information. What this study adds This study shows that an open-source, privacy-preserving large language model pipeline, deployed entirely within hospital infrastructure without task-specific fine-tuning, can extract over 50 registry variables from oncology notes with high accuracy (F1 scores 88-97% across key variables), validated against ground truth checked by two clinicians. Using a structure-aware evaluation framework, we demonstrate that errors can be meaningfully separated into missing, spurious, and incorrect categories, offering clearer insight into model behaviour than aggregate accuracy metrics alone, and show preliminary evidence of transferability to notes from an external setting. How this study might affect research, practice or policy These findings support the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, locally hosted large language models for oncology registry abstraction without requiring identifiable data to leave hospital systems or extensive model customisation. The structure-aware evaluation framework is also shared as a reusable template, enabling other institutions to validate similar AI extraction tools in a consistent, clinically meaningful way before wider implementation.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于研究和诊疗至关重要，但目前仍劳动密集且易出错。本研究开发并评估了一种隐私保护的大语言模型流程，用于真实临床环境中的肿瘤学登记数据提取。方法 在新加坡一家癌症中心部署了一个基于开源Meta Llama 3.3 70B的流程，无需任务特定微调即可提示，从6，700份肿瘤学记录中提取50多个变量。数据在本地采用Hide-In-Plain-Sight方法进行去标识化，确保没有可识别数据离开医院基础设施。在200份随机抽样的记录上评估性能，以经裁定的真实标准为参照，采用结构感知框架将输出分类为正确、缺失、虚假或错误。结果 各变量的F1分数均较高，包括诊断（97.2%）、组织学（95.8%）、分期（92.6%）、生物标志物（91.4%）和治疗（88.1%）。在50份外部记录上的初步可迁移性测试显示，核心诊断变量表现良好，列表值变量表现有所下降。讨论 结构感知评估方法将遗漏与捏造区分开来，比仅使用聚合指标提供了更具临床可操作性的洞见。结论 隐私保护大语言模型在经临床医生核实的参考标准下实现了高提取准确率，支持其在真实临床环境中用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性。关键词：大语言模型；肿瘤学登记数据提取；自然语言处理；隐私保护人工智能；临床数据提取 关于本主题的已知信息 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于癌症研究和诊疗至关重要，但人工操作仍劳动密集、成本高昂，且不同审核者之间结果不一致。大语言模型有潜力实现该任务自动化，但其在真实登记系统中的应用受到患者数据隐私担忧、对任务特定微调的依赖以及评估方法掩盖缺失信息与捏造信息差异等因素的限制。本研究新增的内容 本研究表明，一个开源、隐私保护的大语言模型流程完全部署在医院基础设施内，无需任务特定微调，即可从肿瘤学记录中高准确度提取50多个登记变量（关键变量的F1分数为88-97%），并经过两名临床医生核查的真实标准验证。使用结构感知评估框架，我们证明错误可有意义地分为缺失、虚假和错误类别，比仅使用聚合准确率指标更能清晰反映模型行为，并展示了可迁移至外部环境记录的初步证据。本研究对研究、实践或政策可能产生的影响 这些发现支持部署隐私保护、本地托管的大语言模型用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性，无需可识别数据离开医院系统或进行大量模型定制。结构感知评估框架还作为可复用模板共享，使其他机构能够在更广泛实施前，以一致且具有临床意义的方式验证类似的人工智能提取工具。

papers.title: Sustained Viral Suppression and its association with Psychiatric Morbidity and Sleep Quality among Older Adults with Human Immunodeficiency Virus: Evidence from a Retrospective Cohort in Ibadan, Nigeria.
papers.translated_title: 持续病毒抑制及其与尼日利亚伊巴丹老年人类免疫缺陷病毒感染者精神疾病患病率和睡眠质量的关联：来自回顾性队列研究的证据。
papers.author: Elugbadebo, O. O.
papers.summary: PurposeOlder adults with HIV are at risk of psychiatric disorders and poor sleep quality, but evidence from sub-Saharan Africa is limited, particularly regarding sustained viral suppression. This study examined the prevalence of psychiatric disorders and poor sleep quality symptoms and their association with sustained viral suppression among older adults with HIV in Nigeria. MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted among older adults receiving care at a tertiary HIV clinic in Ibadan, Nigeria. Viral load data from 2019-2023 were abstracted from medical records to determine sustained viral load suppression, while psychiatric morbidity and sleep quality were assessed cross-sectionally in 2023. Psychiatric assessments included major depressive disorder, anxiety disorder, bipolar disorder and mania. Mixed-effects logistic regression assessed changes in viral suppression over time and associations with psychiatric morbidity and sleep quality. ResultsAmong 400 participants, 63.5% were female and mean age was 58.2 years ({+/-} 6.5). A total of 25.8% had major depressive disorder, 17.5% had anxiety disorder, 29.3% had poor sleep quality, 3.3%, bipolar disorder, and 1.0% mania. Viral suppression improved significantly over the retrospective period. Sustained viral suppression was significantly associated with higher odds of good sleep quality (OR = 1.69, 95% CI: 1.07-2.66, p = 0.025), but not psychiatric morbidity. ConclusionPsychiatric disorders and poor sleep quality are common among older adults with HIV in Nigeria. Sustained viral suppression was associated with better sleep quality but not psychiatric morbidity highlighting the importance of integrating mental health and sleep assessment into comprehensive HIV care for older adults.
papers.translated_summary: 目的感染HIV的老年人面临精神障碍和睡眠质量差的风险，但来自撒哈拉以南非洲的证据有限，尤其是关于持续病毒抑制方面。本研究考察了尼日利亚感染HIV的老年人中精神障碍和睡眠质量差症状的患病率及其与持续病毒抑制的关联。方法在尼日利亚伊巴丹一家三级HIV诊所接受治疗的老年人中开展了一项回顾性队列研究。从病历中提取2019—2023年的病毒载量数据以确定持续病毒载量抑制，同时在2023年横断面评估精神疾病患病率和睡眠质量。精神评估包括重性抑郁障碍、焦虑障碍、双相障碍和躁狂。采用混合效应logistic回归评估病毒抑制随时间的变化及其与精神疾病患病率和睡眠质量的关联。结果在400名参与者中，63.5%为女性，平均年龄为58.2岁（±6.5）。共有25.8%患有重性抑郁障碍，17.5%患有焦虑障碍，29.3%睡眠质量差，3.3%患有双相障碍，1.0%患有躁狂。病毒抑制在回顾期内显著改善。持续病毒抑制与良好睡眠质量较高几率显著相关（OR = 1.69，95% CI：1.07-2.66，p = 0.025），但与精神疾病患病率无关。结论精神障碍和睡眠质量差在尼日利亚感染HIV的老年人中常见。持续病毒抑制与更好的睡眠质量相关，但与精神疾病患病率无关，凸显了将心理健康和睡眠评估纳入老年人综合HIV照护的重要性。

papers.title: Convergent and Divergent Neural Signatures of Cue-Induced Response in Substance and Behavioral Addictions: A Coordinate-Based Neuroimaging Meta-Analysis
papers.translated_title: 物质成瘾与行为成瘾中线索诱发反应的汇聚与分离神经特征：一项基于坐标的神经影像元分析
papers.author: Zheng, Q.
papers.summary: Addiction-related cues trigger craving and precipitate relapse, yet whether substance use disorders (SUDs) and behavioral addictions (BAs) share a universal neurobiological cue-reactivity core remains unresolved. We conducted a coordinate-based meta-analysis using Seed-based d Mapping with Permutation of Subject Images (SDM-PSI) to synthesize whole-brain fMRI studies comparing visually evoked cue-reactivity in strictly diagnosed SUDs and BAs versus healthy controls. An updated systematic search through September 12, 2026, yielded 50 eligible articles comprising 53 independent contrasts and 2,578 participants. Pooled analyses across all addictions revealed convergent cue-elicited activations in the mid-cingulate cortex, precentral gyrus, and a midline midbrain region. However, a formal SUD {cap} BA conjunction analysis yielded no family-wise error (FWE)-corrected shared clusters. Direct comparisons demonstrated greater activation in the left hippocampus, pregenual anterior cingulate cortex, and precuneus for SUDs relative to BAs. Importantly, the left hippocampal and precuneus differences survived age adjustment; furthermore, the hippocampal finding remained robust when restricting analyses to highly controlled cue-versus-neutral paradigms, while the precuneus finding was retained within picture-cue modalities. Furthermore, exploratory analyses of clinical characteristics indicated that cue-elicited neural responses were associated with specific clinical states and treatment variables (e.g., methadone maintenance in heroin use disorder), highlighting the modulatory effect of clinical symptom profiles on these regional functional signatures. Overall, the results motivate further investigation of memory- and self-related processes, as well as control- or action-related processes. These findings offer a critical foundation for developing targeted clinical interventions, distinguishing between generalized transdiagnostic neuromodulation targets and disorder-specific therapies tailored to distinct clinical and demographic profile.
papers.translated_summary: 成瘾相关线索会诱发渴求并促发复吸，但物质使用障碍（SUDs）与行为成瘾（BAs）是否共享一个普遍的神经生物学线索反应核心仍未解决。我们采用基于种子的d映射结合受试者图像置换（SDM-PSI）进行基于坐标的元分析，综合比较严格诊断的SUDs和BAs与健康对照之间视觉诱发线索反应的全脑fMRI研究。截至2026年9月12日的更新系统检索获得50篇符合条件的文章，包含53个独立对比和2，578名参与者。跨所有成瘾的汇总分析显示，线索诱发的激活汇聚于中扣带皮层、中央前回和一中线中脑区域。然而，正式的SUD与BA合取分析未产生经家族wise误差（FWE）校正的共享簇。直接比较显示，相对于BAs，SUDs在左侧海马、膝前前扣带皮层和楔前叶激活更强。重要的是，左侧海马和楔前叶差异在年龄校正后仍然存在；此外，当分析限制于高度控制的线索对中性范式时，海马发现仍然稳健，而楔前叶发现在图片线索模态内得以保留。此外，对临床特征的探索性分析表明，线索诱发的神经反应与特定临床状态和治疗变量（例如海洛因使用障碍中的美沙酮维持治疗）相关，突显了临床症状特征对这些区域功能特征的调节作用。总体而言，结果促进了对记忆和自我相关过程以及控制或行动相关过程的进一步研究。这些发现为开发靶向临床干预提供了关键基础，区分了通用的跨诊断神经调控靶点与针对不同临床和人口学特征量身定制的障碍特异性治疗。

papers.title: Morphometric Brain Networks at Ultra-Low Field: A First Assessment of Feasibility and Reliability
papers.translated_title: 超低场下的形态学脑网络：可行性与可靠性的初步评估
papers.author: Karoui, H.
papers.summary: Background: Ultra-low field (ULF) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers accessible point-of-care neuroimaging, yet its capability to support multivariate network analyses remains understudied. Methods: We systematically evaluated the feasibility and reliability of Morphometric Similarity Networks (MSN) and Morphometric Inverse Divergence (MIND) networks derived from paired high-field (HF, 3T/1.5T) and ULF (64mT) scans in a primary cohort(N=23) and an independent replication cohort (N=19). We tested the impact of super-resolution processing, cortical parcellation granularity (Desikan-Killiany vs. Destrieux), and mesh resolution (fsnative vs. fsaverage5) on edge-level cross-scanner agreement (Lin's concordance correlation coefficient, CCC) and subject-level identifiability. Results: MIND networks demonstrated higher edge-level HF-ULF agreement (mean CCC = 0.95) and ULF reproducibility (mean CCC = 0.98) compared to MSNs (mean CCC = 0.86-0.87 and 0.91-0.94, respectively). In contrast, MSNs yielded higher subject-level differential identifiability across field strengths due to a broader distinction between within- and between-subject similarity. Reconstructing MIND networks on native high-resolution meshes (fsnative) maximised cross-scanner agreement, whereas coarser meshes and finer cortical parcellations enhanced individual network identifiability. Conclusions: Structural similarity networks can be reliably constructed from ULF MRI data. Optimal analytic choices depend on study objectives: MIND on native meshes maximises cross-scanner stability, whereas MSNs excel at preserving individual uniqueness, paving the way for globally scalable connectomic research.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：超低场（ULF）磁共振成像（MRI）提供了可及的就床旁神经影像，但其支持多变量网络分析的能力仍研究不足。方法：我们在一个主队列（N=23）和一个独立重复队列（N=19）中，系统评估了从配对高场（HF，3T/1.5T）和ULF（64mT）扫描中衍生的形态相似性网络（MSN）和形态逆散度（MIND）网络的可行性与可靠性。我们检验了超分辨率处理、皮层分区粒度（Desikan-Killiany vs. Destrieux）以及网格分辨率（fsnative vs. fsaverage5）对边水平跨扫描仪一致性（Lin一致性相关系数，CCC）和受试者水平可识别性的影响。结果：与MSN相比（平均CCC分别为0.86-0.87和0.91-0.94），MIND网络表现出更高的边水平HF-ULF一致性（平均CCC = 0.95）和ULF可重复性（平均CCC = 0.98）。相反，由于受试者内与受试者间相似性之间更广泛的区分，MSN在跨场强下产生了更高的受试者水平差异可识别性。在原生高分辨率网格（fsnative）上重建MIND网络最大化了跨扫描仪一致性，而较粗的网格和更精细的皮层分区增强了个体网络可识别性。结论：结构相似性网络可以从ULF MRI数据中可靠构建。最佳分析选择取决于研究目标：原生网格上的MIND最大化跨扫描仪稳定性，而MSN在保留个体独特性方面表现优异，为全球可扩展的连接组学研究铺平了道路。

papers.title: Estimating the correlation between rates of change in longitudinal studies in presence of dropout
papers.translated_title: 在存在脱落的情况下估计纵向研究中变化率之间的相关性
papers.author: Dörfel, R. P.
papers.summary: Estimating the correlation between subject-specific rates of change is a common objective in longitudinal studies. A natural approach is to fit ordinary least squares regressions per subject and correlate the resulting slope estimates directly. Under complete data, this slopes-first estimator is algebraically equivalent to a contrast-based plug-in estimator derived from the joint variance-covariance matrix of the two signals across time. Under independent dropout, however, the slopes-first approach implicitly applies heterogeneous weights across missing-data patterns, introducing bias whenever the cross-covariance between the two signals is not constant over time. We formalise this result and propose an unbiased alternative that estimates the joint covariance matrix before applying the contrast. We further extend our results to include covariates as well. Simulations confirm that the slopes-first estimator is biased under non-constant cross-covariance while the proposed alternative remains unbiased. Further, we show in a real-world example that the two estimators can lead to different scientific conclusions and recommend that researchers working with longitudinal data inspect the missing data pattern to make an informed decision about the estimator of choice.
papers.translated_summary: 估计特定个体变化率之间的相关性是纵向研究中的一个常见目标。一种自然的方法是对每个个体分别拟合普通最小二乘回归，并直接对所得的斜率估计值求相关。在完整数据下，这种斜率优先估计量在代数上等价于由两个信号跨时间的联合方差-协方差矩阵导出的基于对比的插入估计量。然而，在独立缺失机制下，斜率优先方法隐含地对不同缺失数据模式施加异质权重，只要两个信号之间的交叉协方差随时间不是常数，就会引入偏差。我们形式化了这一结果，并提出了一种无偏的替代方法，即在应用对比之前先估计联合协方差矩阵。我们进一步将结果扩展到包含协变量的情形。模拟证实，在交叉协方差非常数时，斜率优先估计量是有偏的，而所提出的替代方法保持无偏。此外，我们在一个真实世界示例中表明，这两种估计量可能导致不同的科学结论，并建议处理纵向数据的研究人员检查缺失数据模式，以便对估计量的选择做出有依据的决策。

papers.title: Determining context-specific economically feasible age ranges for female HPV catch-up vaccination in LMICs: a model-based health economic assessment
papers.translated_title: 确定中低收入国家女性HPV补种疫苗的特定情境经济可行年龄范围：基于模型的卫生经济学评估
papers.author: Man, I.
papers.summary: To support the WHO global strategy to accelerate cervical cancer elimination in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), we conducted a comprehensive health-economic impact assessment of HPV catch-up vaccination across different age ranges up to age 30, using IARCs METHIS modelling platform. A one-time catch-up campaign (targeting HPV 16/18; 90% coverage) in 2026 across 132 LMICs among females aged 9-30 could prevent 6.93 million cervical cancer cases and 3.56 million deaths, on top of 2.70 and 1.57 million cases and deaths averted by past vaccination, requiring 951 million doses and 11,349 million US$. Median country-specific costs represented 0.17% of five-year health expenditure and 19.7% of immunization budgets. Among six countries with diverse epidemiological profiles and sufficient data for cost-effectiveness analyses, catch-up was cost-effective until age 30 in all but one country, where it was cost-effective until age 23 only. Female catch-up could be cost-effective and impactful for cervical cancer prevention in LMICs.
papers.translated_summary: 为支持世界卫生组织在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）加速消除宫颈癌的全球战略，我们利用国际癌症研究机构（IARC）的METHIS建模平台，对不同年龄范围（至30岁）的HPV补种疫苗接种进行了全面的健康经济影响评估。2026年在132个LMICs中针对9-30岁女性开展一次性补种活动（针对HPV 16/18；覆盖率90%），可在既往疫苗接种已避免270万例宫颈癌病例和157万例死亡的基础上，额外预防693万例宫颈癌病例和356万例死亡，需9.51亿剂疫苗和113.49亿美元。各国成本中位数占五年卫生支出的0.17%，占免疫规划预算的19.7%。在六个具有不同流行病学特征且数据足以进行成本效果分析的国家中，除一个国家仅至23岁具有成本效果外，其余国家补种至30岁均具有成本效果。女性补种对LMICs的宫颈癌预防具有成本效果和显著影响。

papers.title: Individual-level Structural Neuroimaging Biomarkers across the Psychosis Spectrum
papers.translated_title: 个体水平的结构神经影像生物标志物在精神病谱系中的研究
papers.author: Rivas, A. M.
papers.summary: Background and Hypothesis: Although psychotic disorders are characterized by widespread cortical thinning, translating these findings into individualized biomarkers remains challenging. Regional Vulnerability Index (RVI) and Neuroscore are candidate individual-level biomarkers that quantify the similarity between an individual's structural brain pattern and generic psychosis-associated alterations. This study investigated cortical thickness (CT)-based RVI and Neuroscore, along with mean CT deviation from healthy individuals, across the psychosis spectrum. Study Design: Using structural 3T MRI data from 289 participants (clinical high risk for psychosis [CHR], n=39; first episode psychosis [FEP], n=44, chronic psychosis [CP], n=86; healthy controls [HC], n=120), RVI, Neuroscore, and mean CT deviation (z) scores were computed from region-wise CT measures quantified using FreeSurfer v7.2. Group differences and associations with symptoms were evaluated. Study Results: RVI and Neuroscore were significantly higher, and mean CT z-scores lower, in FEP and CP compared with CHR and HC, with moderate-to-large effect sizes (|Cohen's d| = 0.55-1.15). No differences were observed between FEP and CP or CHR and HC. Indices were not associated with psychosis-spectrum symptom severity in the CHR, FEP, or CP groups. RVI (r = -0.561, p < .001) and Neuroscore (r = -0.997, p < .001) were strongly negatively correlated with the mean CT z-score. Conclusions: CT-based RVI and Neuroscore appear to index established disease status but not risk status, while showing substantial overlap with mean CT deviation. These findings highlight the need to further refine these biomarkers through data-driven and multimodal approaches to improve their utility for risk and prognostic prediction.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与假设：尽管精神障碍以广泛的皮层变薄为特征，但将这些发现转化为个体化生物标志物仍具有挑战性。区域脆弱性指数（RVI）和神经评分（Neuroscore）是候选的个体水平生物标志物，可量化个体结构脑模式与一般性精神病相关改变之间的相似性。本研究考察了基于皮层厚度（CT）的RVI和神经评分，以及健康个体的平均CT偏差，在精神病谱系中的表现。研究设计：使用289名参与者（精神病临床高风险[CHR]，n=39；首发精神病[FEP]，n=44；慢性精神病[CP]，n=86；健康对照[HC]，n=120）的结构3T MRI数据，基于使用FreeSurfer v7.2量化的区域CT指标计算RVI、神经评分和平均CT偏差（z）分数。评估了组间差异及与症状的关联。研究结果：与CHR和HC相比，FEP和CP的RVI和神经评分显著更高，平均CT z分数更低，效应量为中到大（|Cohen's d| = 0.55-1.15）。FEP与CP之间或CHR与HC之间未观察到差异。在CHR、FEP或CP组中，这些指标与精神病谱系症状严重程度无关。RVI（r = -0.561，p < .001）和神经评分（r = -0.997，p < .001）与平均CT z分数呈强负相关。结论：基于CT的RVI和神经评分似乎反映已确立的疾病状态而非风险状态，同时与平均CT偏差存在显著重叠。这些发现凸显了通过数据驱动和多模态方法进一步优化这些生物标志物的必要性，以提高其在风险和预后预测中的效用。

papers.title: An interpretable whole-blood transcriptomic model for Parkinson disease identification and molecular profiling
papers.translated_title: 一个用于帕金森病识别和分子谱分析的可解释全血转录组模型
papers.author: Li, Y.
papers.summary: Background Sporadic Parkinson disease (PD) lacks a molecular taxonomy that stratifies patients by dominant molecular drivers, limiting enrollment for disease-modifying trials, especially anti-inflammatory agents targeting NLRP3/NF-{kappa}B. Methods We developed ORIGIN-PD, an interpretable whole-blood transcriptomic classifier comprising 34 gene-level features and a composite low-expression score, with gene-level contributions organized into eight prespecified functional modules: midbrain dopaminergic (mDA) neuron identity/development, pathway-related, oxidative/mitochondrial, proteostasis, inflammation/ immunity, microglia, ncRNA, and other. Using LASSO regression on stringently quality-controlled whole-blood RNA-seq data from the Parkinson Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) (Training Set: 204 PD and 92 controls; Locked Test Set: 51 PD and 23 controls), we assigned each patient a module-contribution profile. Module dominance was defined as >30% of total score. Results ORIGIN-PD discriminated PD from controls with high accuracy (Locked Test Set AUC 0.944, sensitivity 0.843, specificity 0.913). Among 255 sporadic PD patients, 49.4% exhibited a dominant module-contribution pattern, most frequently mDA neuron identity/development (22.0%), followed by pathway-related (11.8%), microglia/glial (7.5%), and inflammation/immunity (3.5%). Among the 50.6% with multi-module contributions, mDA neuron identity/development ranked in the top three in 62.8% of patients versus 35.7% for inflammation/immunity, indicating broader involvement of mDA neuron identity genes than inflammatory genes. The model showed high specificity against Alzheimer disease, ALS, and inflammatory controls. Conclusions ORIGIN-PD enables rational enrichment for NLRP3/NF-{kappa}B inhibitor trials by identifying patients with inflammatory involvement. In addition, the predominant contribution of the mDA neuron identity/development module, centred on WNT1, MSX1, NPM1, and LMX1B, identifies a larger patient subgroup with altered expression of mDA neuron identity module genes, suggesting that ORIGIN-PD may also be useful for patient enrichment in future trials of Wnt/{beta}-catenin pathway agonists. This dual-purpose framework provides a transparent, interpretable basis for pathogenic subtyping and precision enrichment in sporadic PD, with the aim of guiding disease-modifying therapy.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 散发性帕金森病（PD）缺乏按主要分子驱动因素对患者进行分层的分子分类体系，限制了疾病修饰试验的入组，尤其是针对NLRP3/NF-{kappa}B的抗炎药物试验。方法 我们开发了ORIGIN-PD，一种可解释的全血转录组分类器，包含34个基因水平特征和一个复合低表达评分，基因水平贡献被组织为八个预设功能模块：中脑多巴胺能（mDA）神经元身份/发育、通路相关、氧化/线粒体、蛋白质稳态、炎症/免疫、小胶质细胞、ncRNA及其他。利用LASSO回归对来自帕金森进展标志物计划（PPMI）的严格质量控制全血RNA-seq数据（训练集：204例PD和92例对照；锁定测试集：51例PD和23例对照）进行分析，我们为每位患者分配了模块贡献谱。模块优势定义为占总评分>30%。结果 ORIGIN-PD以高准确度区分PD与对照（锁定测试集AUC 0.944，敏感性0.843，特异性0.913）。在255例散发性PD患者中，49.4%表现出优势模块贡献模式，最常见的是mDA神经元身份/发育（22.0%），其次是通路相关（11.8%）、小胶质细胞/胶质（7.5%）和炎症/免疫（3.5%）。在50.6%具有多模块贡献的患者中，mDA神经元身份/发育在62.8%的患者中位列前三，而炎症/免疫为35.7%，表明mDA神经元身份基因的参与比炎症基因更广泛。该模型对阿尔茨海默病、ALS和炎症对照显示出高特异性。结论 ORIGIN-PD通过识别具有炎症参与的患者，为NLRP3/NF-{kappa}B抑制剂试验提供了合理的富集策略。此外，以WNT1、MSX1、NPM1和LMX1B为中心的mDA神经元身份/发育模块的主要贡献，识别出一个更大的mDA神经元身份模块基因表达改变的患者亚组，提示ORIGIN-PD也可能有助于未来Wnt/{beta}-catenin通路激动剂试验的患者富集。这一双用途框架为散发性PD的致病亚型和精准富集提供了透明、可解释的基础，旨在指导疾病修饰治疗。
